test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT associated with the Industrial Policy Resolution, 1956?

options.text: A system of licenses for the private sector was introduced.
It classified industries into three categories.
It formed the basis of the Third Five Year Plan.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It formed the basis of the Third Five Year Plan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956 did not form the basis of the Third Five Year Plan. The Third Five Year Plan was introduced in 1961 and had different objectives and goals.
 
• The resolution did introduce a system of licenses for the private sector, classifying industries into three categories, and promoted regional equality.
 
• The Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956 aimed at the establishment of a socialistic pattern of society where the state would play a dominant role in the industrial sector.
 
• It laid the foundation for the development of public sector enterprises and sought to reduce regional imbalances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956 was a significant policy document that shaped the industrial landscape of post-independence India.
 
• It categorized industries into three schedules: Schedule A included industries exclusively under state control, Schedule B included industries where the state would play a dominant role, and Schedule C included all remaining industries.
 
• The policy aimed to accelerate the rate of growth and industrialization, create more employment opportunities, and reduce income and wealth inequalities.
 
• The policy also aimed at fostering the development of small-scale industries to promote balanced regional growth.
